mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-quarter acceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals increased aggregate demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, particularly when accompanied by rising industrial production (INDPRO).
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 2% above its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (p < 0.05) in periods when GDPC1 and INDPRO jointly exceed their moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% signals a shift to an accommodative monetary policy regime, which reduces borrowing costs and supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p < 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS < 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8% signals weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, particularly when accompanied by declining payroll employment (PAYEMS).
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (p < 0.05) in periods when UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-quarter decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, particularly when accompanied by declining industrial production (INDPRO).
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (p < 0.05) in periods when RSAFS and INDPRO jointly fall below their moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, particularly when accompanied by rising real GDP growth (GDPC1).
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher (p < 0.05) in periods when INDPRO and GDPC1 jointly exceed their moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals a shift to a restrictive monetary policy regime, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (t-test p < 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tight labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, particularly when accompanied by rising payroll employment (PAYEMS).
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (p < 0.05) in periods when UNRATE < 6% and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-quarter increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, particularly when accompanied by rising real GDP growth (GDPC1).
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises above its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (p < 0.05) in periods when RSAFS and GDPC1 jointly exceed their moving averages.
